verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own AI assistant can 'check your calendar', and the AI can be connected to Calendar to automate workflows from the inbox. That gives indirect, AI-mediated calendar visibility. Nothing documents a native calendar view, responding to meeting invites, or creating events inside the client. missing for 10: native in-client calendar view, invite accept/decline handling, event creation, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see my calendar, respond to invites, and create events without leaving the email client

citations.quote: it can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, check your calendar, and more.
Connect the AI to your Slack, Calendar, Notion, Asana, Hubspot, and more so you can automate workflows without ever leaving your inbox.
